legalName: Motion to Restrict and Seal Records of a Misdemeanor Conviction under the Georgia Second Chance Act
boundCodifiedTextRole: codified-text source only - the controlling Georgia legal review, whose Part 3 custom-pleading specification grounds the caption structure, pleading title, citations, proposed-order requirements and certificate of service; it is not included in the packet

componentConditions.exhibit_b_criminal_history: Attach this only where you rely on it or the court expects it.
componentConditions.exhibit_c_sentence_completion: Attach this only where you have it, such as a probation termination order.
componentConditions.exhibit_d_supporting_exhibits: Attach these only where you choose to supply them.

routeSelectionNote: The composed pages carry no election control. The statutory route is stated in the instrument's own title and body, which is where this family's route determination lives. No participant-facing election is route-determined on this family.

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date the adjudication of guilt was entered
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date the adjudication of guilt was entered
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date the adjudication of guilt was entered, from the final disposition - the clerk of the convicting court holds it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of arrest in this case
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of arrest in this case
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of arrest, taken from the case papers or your Georgia criminal history report

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court and county named in the caption - the court that entered the conviction, and its county (State, Superior, Magistrate, Probate or Municipal; your own case papers name both, and the instructions page says who can confirm them)
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court and county named in the caption - the court that entered the conviction, and its county (State, Superior, Magistrate, Probate or Municipal; your own case papers name both, and the instructions page says who can confirm them)
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which court handled the case, and its level - State, Superior, Magistrate, Probate or Municipal - is data the participant's own case papers carry; the packet must not default to Superior Court
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name and level of the court that entered the conviction, and its county, from your case papers - the clerk of the convicting court can confirm both

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number of the existing criminal case, exactly as it appears on the court record
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number of the existing criminal case, exactly as it appears on the court record
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the filing is made in the existing criminal case under the existing case number, and that number lives on a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case number of the existing criminal case, copied exactly from the court record - the clerk of the convicting court holds the case papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Exact O.C.G.A. Code section of the misdemeanor conviction to be restricted
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Exact O.C.G.A. Code section of the misdemeanor conviction to be restricted
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no charge fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the exact O.C.G.A. Code section you were convicted under, from the final disposition - the offense label is not enough; the exclusions turn on the exact Code section

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: GCIC Offender Tracking Number (OTN) for the case, where known
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: GCIC Offender Tracking Number (OTN) for the case, where known
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the OTN lives on the criminal history record, which the platform never collects, inspects or authenticates
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the GCIC OTN for the case, copied from your Georgia criminal history report where it appears - the proposed order needs it to be actionable by GCIC, and the packet is usable without it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Your own statement of what has changed in your life and how this record has been a barrier
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Your own statement of what has changed in your life and how this record has been a barrier
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform prompts for and formats the participant's own account; it does not write the privacy-harm narrative
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own first-hand account of what has changed and how the record has been a barrier - these lines are yours alone and nothing on them is written for you

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Terms of the sentence, itemized, and the date every term was completed
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Terms of the sentence, itemized, and the date every term was completed
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no sentence fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: each term of the sentence - probation, fines, restitution - and the date you finished the last of them, checked against the final disposition or a probation termination order

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of arrest identified in the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of arrest identified in the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of arrest, from the case papers or your Georgia criminal history report - the order names it so the agencies can identify the cycle

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: GCIC Offender Tracking Number (OTN) for the case, where known - proposed order caption

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the OTN lives on the criminal history record, which the platform never collects, inspects or authenticates
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the GCIC OTN for the case, copied from your Georgia criminal history report where it appears - the proposed order needs it to be actionable by GCIC, and the packet is usable without it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: OTN of the case, stated in the proposed order so the order is actionable by GCIC
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: OTN of the case, stated in the proposed order so the order is actionable by GCIC
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the OTN lives on the criminal history record, which the platform never collects, inspects or authenticates
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the GCIC OTN, copied from your Georgia criminal history report where it appears - a restriction order that does not identify the case for GCIC is not actionable

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Name and mailing address of the prosecuting attorney served, identified as District Attorney or Solicitor-General for the county
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Name and mailing address of the prosecuting attorney served, identified as District Attorney or Solicitor-General for the county
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no address for the prosecuting attorney and the participant writes it before service
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name and mailing address of the prosecuting attorney - District Attorney or Solicitor-General - for the county where you file; the clerk's office can provide it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Method used to serve each recipient, chosen from those the certificate lists
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Method used to serve each recipient, chosen from those the certificate lists
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which method the participant uses is settled only when service actually happens
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: how you actually served each recipient - certified mail, e-filing or hand delivery - confirmed with the clerk of the court named in the caption before filing, because local courts control their own filing and e-filing practice
